scope: Read the full Japanese list and all twelve translations; checked each of the five original YouTube IDs, their titles, availability, genre labels, and localized metadata.
findings: Removed the duplicate future date, retained original date 2022-09-08, and set lastmod to the review date.
One original embed, bQXCx1F7nhs (Electro Swing Collection), returned HTTP 404 from YouTube oEmbed; removed it from all languages.
The remaining four IDs returned metadata. Corrected the second title to the current video title, Café Swing | Electro Swing Mix 2019.
Added direct YouTube watch links beside each remaining embed in all languages.
Replaced the focus/quality recommendation framing with a neutral list description; playback taste and concentration effects are subjective.
